executeLoan(((address,address,(uint8,add.details: Although there is no distinction between Orders in Seaport, we need         to make a distinction to identify the Lender and Borrower, verify that         the recipient of the NFTs is set as Pinkwhale and that the respective         terms are indeed matching with the hash provided in zoneHash.

params.borrowerOrder: (Seaport specific) The Order with the NFT to collateralised set as                            offer item.
params.borrowerTerms: The Terms used to generate the zoneHash of the borrowerOrder.                            This is necessary to validate that the Terms are respected.
params.criteriaResolvers: (Seaport specific) An array where each element contains a                            reference to a specific order as well as that                            order's offer or consideration, a token                            identifier, and a proof that the supplied                            token identifier is contained in the                            order's merkle root.
params.fulfillments: (Seaport specific) An array of elements allocating offer                            components to consideration components.
params.lenderOrder: (Seaport specific) The Order with the NFT to collateralised set as                            consideration item and Pinkwhale set as the consideration                            recipient.
params.lenderTerms: The Terms used to generate the zoneHash of the lenderOrder.                            This is necessary to validate that the Terms are respected.
